q.songTitle: Let’s Not Shit Ourselves (To Love and to Be Loved)
q.line: While a million objects pass through my periphery
stanza: So now I try to keep up, I've been exchanging my currency
While a million objects pass through my periphery
Now I'm rubbing my eyes 'cause they're starting to bother me
I've been staring too long at the screen
But where was it when I first heard that sweet sound of humility?!
It came to my ears in the goddamn loveliest melody
How grateful I was, then, to be part of the mystery
To love and to be loved
Let's just hope that is enough! Woah!

partner.line: But where was it when I first heard that sweet sound of humility?!
